calibration_check.note: trap-realism failed 57/60, so a metadata-only read would over-report; but 51 of 53 failed items carry an independent method or followability defect, so the rate is not a metadata artifact

dominant_defect_class: within-template description/operation misalignment: step descriptions carried over from a sibling example or offset by one example, contradicting the operations they label; plus technique mislabelling (template name != method taught) and junk result fields

deterministic_scan.signature: description cites numbers absent from its own example
deterministic_scan.limitation: catches only number-bearing descriptions; misses carried-over prose with no distinctive numerals (e.g. "Add the partial products to get final result"), which the panels found repeatedly — the true prevalence lies between 9.7% and the sampled 88.3%

serving_consequence: these 823 templates overlap the served Tier-1 pool 766/777 and are labelled static_verified, which certifies question+answer only — this sample says the WALKTHROUGHS are unreliable at scale
